headline: OpenRAC expands mod installation while Going Commando reaches 7760 matched functions
summary: OpenRAC's Development line gained mod browsing, dependency installation and automatic updates, plus fixes for Windows sound gaps, diagonal movement and phone graphics performance. The stable branch received a PAL level 11 lighting preparation fix (OpenRAC#189). Going Commando reached 7760 of 8579 matched functions, about 84.7% of code by size; matched functions compile to the original game's exact bytes. Ratchet & Clank focused on source readability and C data, while Deadlocked integrated more PAL matches. Mod SDK 1.11.0, Archipelago 2.1.0, item-randomizer 1.0.4 and Difficulty 1.2.4 were published, with mod work protecting Archipelago saves across rooms and preserving Blarg Station's own spawns.
